To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
elderly patients in a geriatric ward are characterized by a high level of health problems and need fulfillment deficiencies.

the elderly patients in geriatric ward are characterized by low and average functional efficiency and the highest level of need fulfillment deficiency in the group of patients with multi illness and in the eldest age groups.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the assessment of the level of the health problems, nursing and care needs of elderly people in the context of selected functional efficiency parameters.
the assessment of health, nursing, psychological and social status of elderly patients, as well as the level of bio psycho social need fulfillment in the view of selected parameters.
the assessment of the level of health and nursing problems in geriatric population in a view of the selected parameters of functional assessment and bio psycho social need deficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the level of health problems, nursing care needs, functional efficiency as well as the level of bio psycho social need fulfillment in elderly patients is related to the age of patients as well as to the level of their functional efficiency and the number of illnesses.
in geriatric patients, the level of need fulfilment and the risk of bed soers are related to functional efficiency and the number of illnesses.
the health and nursing problems of the elderly are related to bio psycho and social need deficiencies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are not only concerned with the elderly but also with the young and the middle-aged.
the elderly patients in our group were suffering from multi illness, were endangered by risk for bed sores and showed high need fulfillment deficiencies.
we need to be able to assess the needs of our patients, and then we need to be prepared to provide care that meets these needs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a simple questionnaire to assess functional status can be a useful screening tool to identify patients who may need additional assessment for the presence of delirium.
the elderly patients with multi illnesses, functional inefficiency and high need fulfillment deficiency require more intensive nursing care, which is a challenge for the nursing staff.
the health problems of the elderly patients are related to the bio psycho social need deficiency and functional assessment.
